cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(maestro_node VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo CACHE STRING "Build type" FORCE)
endif()

option(MAESTRO_WITH_OTEL  "Build with the OpenTelemetry C++ SDK" ON)
option(MAESTRO_BUILD_TESTS "Build the unit test suite" ON)

include(cmake/Dependencies.cmake)

# --- FlatBuffers bindings (generated by `make schema` from the repo root) -----
set(MAESTRO_GENERATED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated)
file(GLOB MAESTRO_FBS_HEADERS ${MAESTRO_GENERATED_DIR}/*_generated.h)
if(NOT MAESTRO_FBS_HEADERS)
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "No generated FlatBuffers headers in ${MAESTRO_GENERATED_DIR}.\n"
    "Run `make schema` from the repository root first.")
endif()

# --- Core library shared by the node binary and the tests --------------------
add_library(maestro_core
  src/net/framing.cpp
  src/obs.cpp
)
target_include_directories(maestro_core PUBLIC include ${MAESTRO_GENERATED_DIR})
target_compile_features(maestro_core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(maestro_core PUBLIC
  flatbuffers::flatbuffers
  asio::asio
  Threads::Threads
)

if(MAESTRO_WITH_OTEL)
  target_compile_definitions(maestro_core PUBLIC MAESTRO_WITH_OTEL=1)
  target_link_libraries(maestro_core PUBLIC
    opentelemetry_trace
    opentelemetry_exporter_otlp_grpc
  )
endif()

if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(maestro_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()

# Optional sanitizers, e.g. `-DMAESTRO_SANITIZE=address,undefined` (or `thread`).
# Applied to `maestro_core` and propagated to the node binary and tests. The
# fetched dependencies are not instrumented, which is fine for ASan/UBSan.
set(MAESTRO_SANITIZE "" CACHE STRING
  "Comma-separated sanitizers to build with (e.g. address,undefined or thread)")
if(MAESTRO_SANITIZE)
  target_compile_options(maestro_core PUBLIC
    -fsanitize=${MAESTRO_SANITIZE} -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
  target_link_options(maestro_core PUBLIC -fsanitize=${MAESTRO_SANITIZE})
endif()

# --- Node executable ---------------------------------------------------------
add_executable(maestro-node src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(maestro-node PRIVATE maestro_core)

# --- Tests -------------------------------------------------------------------
if(MAESTRO_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(maestro_tests
    tests/test_framing.cpp
    tests/test_schema.cpp
  )
  target_link_libraries(maestro_tests PRIVATE maestro_core GTest::gtest_main)
  include(GoogleTest)
  gtest_discover_tests(maestro_tests)
endif()
